Policy Change.definition: Whether or how the policy may change, and how users are told.

Third Party Sharing/Collection.definition: Disclosure of user information to third parties, or collection of it by third parties.

User Choice/Control.definition: Choices users have about collection, use, or sharing, including consent and opting out.

Data Retention.definition: How long user information is kept, or what decides the storage period.

User Access Edit and Deletion.definition: Whether and how users can access, correct, update, or delete their information.

International and Specific Audiences.definition: Practices for specific groups, such as children or residents of particular regions.

Data Security.definition: Measures that protect user information, or statements about its security.

Do Not Track.definition: Whether and how browser Do Not Track signals are honored.

First Party Collection/Use.definition: Information the service provider collects or uses, including how and why.

Other.definition: Introductions, general statements, scope, headings, dates, contact information, and practices outside the nine.
